consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: classification of a space and issue of an entry permit

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: unplanned release of kinetic energy at P-9503

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control CONFINED_SPACE_ENTRY_PERMIT: the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next field verification that the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit on P-9503 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in rescuing from a confined space, specifically planning and rehearsing non-entry rescue. P-9503 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during routine operation while the classification of a space and issue of an entry permit had been bypassed. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 17 December 2015 a hazard report was recorded on P-9503 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during routine operation; kinetic energy held as rotating equipment was not released.
